title: Blue Turns Right
reference: repeat 3 { F1(9) turn_right } def F1 { if wall_ahead { turn_left turn_left } else { forward if tile_is b { turn_right } F1 if tile_is b { turn_left } forward } }
hints: These arms bend right at blue. The mirror of a right turn is a left turn.
F1: if wall ahead, turn left twice, else forward, if blue turn right, F1, if blue turn left, forward. Main: repeat 3 of F1(9), turn right.
repeat 3 { F1(9) turn_right } def F1 { if wall_ahead { turn_left turn_left } else { forward if tile_is b { turn_right } F1 if tile_is b { turn_left } forward } }
